_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site D#000.src: You need the crystal shard from WynnExcavation Site C to start this quest!
WynnExcavation Site D#000.dst: このクエストを始めるには、WynnExcavation C 地点のクリスタルの欠片が必要だ！

WynnExcavation Site D#001.src: He received a message and made his way frantically down to the panic room, which is somewhere inside of this throne room.
WynnExcavation Site D#001.dst: 伝令を受け取るや、慌てて緊急避難室へ降りていかれました。この玉座の間のどこかにあります。
WynnExcavation Site D#001.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#002.src: The panic room is hidden somewhere in here, we just need to figure out how to open it...
WynnExcavation Site D#002.dst: 緊急避難室はこのどこかに隠されている。あとは開け方を突き止めるだけだ……

WynnExcavation Site D#003.src: Last I heard from His Majesty, he was muttering something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.dst: 陛下から最後に聞いたときは、四つめのクリスタルについて何かつぶやいておられました……緑色のものだと。

WynnExcavation Site D#004.src: And then he said "The order of the crystals will open the way". Maybe it's a clue as to how to find him?
WynnExcavation Site D#004.dst: それから「クリスタルの順序が道を開く」と。陛下を見つける手がかりかもしれません。
WynnExcavation Site D#004.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#006.dst: どうか、わたしの前から去ってくれ……

WynnExcavation Site D#007.src: What are you still doing here? Get out of the city!
WynnExcavation Site D#007.dst: まだここで何をしている？この街から出ろ！

WynnExcavation Site D#009.src: Thanks for helping with that long task...
WynnExcavation Site D#009.dst: 長い仕事を手伝ってくれてありがとう……

WynnExcavation Site D#010.src: Here, I've combined the map fragments behind me. It looks like it's deep in the jungle, I wonder where...
WynnExcavation Site D#010.dst: ほら、後ろにある地図の欠片を繋ぎ合わせた。ジャングルの奥地のようだが、いったいどこだろう…
WynnExcavation Site D#010.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#011.src: Quickly, you must reach the last crystal before WynnExcavation! It's in the {p}, there must be a building like the one on the map
WynnExcavation Site D#011.dst: 急げ、WynnExcavation より先に最後のクリスタルへたどり着かねばならん！それは{p}にある。地図にあるような建物が必ずあるはずだ

WynnExcavation Site D#012.src: You don't get it, do you? We needed you from the start. These otherworldly crystals are a powerful magic, but a dangerous one at that.
WynnExcavation Site D#012.dst: まだわからないのか？我々にはお前が必要だった。異界のクリスタルは強力な魔法だが、同時に危険でもある。
WynnExcavation Site D#012.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#013.src: Step into this hole, and accept your fate. It's over, you've lost!
WynnExcavation Site D#013.dst: この穴に足を踏み入れ、己の運命を受け入れろ。もう終わりだ、お前の負けだ！

WynnExcavation Site D#014.src: I see you have finally shown up.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.dst: ようやく姿を見せたか。

WynnExcavation Site D#015.src: There is no chance someone as weak as you can beat Amadel!
WynnExcavation Site D#015.dst: お前のように弱い者が Amadel に勝てるわけがない！

WynnExcavation Site D#017.dst: あれはまぐれにすぎん……

WynnExcavation Site D#019.dst: あの方はまだ準備運動をしているだけだ……

WynnExcavation Site D#020.src: THIS ISN'T EVEN HIS FINAL FORM!
WynnExcavation Site D#020.dst: これですら最終形態ではないのだ！

WynnExcavation Site D#021.src: I, I can't believe you beat him...
WynnExcavation Site D#021.dst: ま、まさかあの方に勝つとは……

WynnExcavation Site D#022.src: Amadel was a god... He was going to save the province...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.dst: Amadel は神だった……この地方を救うはずだったのに……

WynnExcavation Site D#023.src: He told me that the Wynn province will never find solace. I never truly understood why, until now.
WynnExcavation Site D#023.dst: Wynn 地方に安らぎが訪れることはないと、あの方は言っていた。今になるまで、その意味が本当には分からなかった。

WynnExcavation Site D#024.src: You see, many forces are at work on our lands that we cannot physically see, but the outcome of the influences cannot be ignored.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.dst: いいか、この地には目に見えぬ多くの力が働いている。だが、その影響がもたらす結果は無視できぬ。

WynnExcavation Site D#025.src: Creatures that you can find in Wynn may not exist in Gavel. In Gavel, there are many magical beings. Creatures influenced by forces other than the Corruption. Not all of them are friendly, mind.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.dst: Wynn にいる生き物が Gavel にいるとは限らぬ。Gavel には魔法の生き物が多くいる。腐敗とは別の力に影響された生き物だ。ただし、すべてが友好的とは思わぬようにな。

WynnExcavation Site D#026.src: But rarely do you see the undead in such numbers. You know, there is a fundamental law of our land, when two forces collide, there is war.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.dst: だが、あれほどの数のアンデッドを見ることは滅多にない。この地には根本の法則がある――二つの力がぶつかれば、戦争になるのだ。

WynnExcavation Site D#027.src: This could be people, species, or anything, really. And I think the same thing can be said for the energy that resonate in those crystals you have there.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.dst: それは人でも、種族でも、本当に何でもありうる。そして、お前が持っているそのクリスタルの中で響いている力にも、同じことが言えると思う。

WynnExcavation Site D#028.src: I think those crystals represent a force far beyond what we can grasp, and if that power can turn one man into what you fought back there, I shudder to think what else it could do.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.dst: あのクリスタルは、我々の理解の及ばぬ力を表しているのだと思う。その力が一人の人間をお前が今そこで戦ったものに変えられるのなら、ほかに何ができるのか考えるだけで身震いがする。

WynnExcavation Site D#029.src: The Olm in the jungle clearly knew of this, too, as they met their eventual demise. Their desperation most likely led to them attempting to harness that power, as well.
WynnExcavation Site D#029.dst: ジャングルの Olm もこれを知っていたのだろう。やつらは結局滅びたのだからな。追い詰められた末に、やつらもその力を手に入れようとしたに違いない。

WynnExcavation Site D#030.src: These are things that the mages of the ocean have studied in secret for centuries. We may never know, and rather, I think we never should know.
WynnExcavation Site D#030.dst: これらは海の魔術師たちが何世紀も密かに研究してきたことだ。我々は永久に知ることはないだろう――いや、むしろ永久に知るべきではないと思う。

WynnExcavation Site D#031.src: If Amadel taught us anything, it's that we can never be trusted with power. Here, put that crystal into the lava. Let it burn and never be used. The king places the crystals in the lava, and watches them sink.
WynnExcavation Site D#031.dst: Amadel が我々に教えたことがあるとすれば、それは「力は誰にも託せぬ」ということだ。さあ、そのクリスタルを溶岩に入れてくれ。焼かせて、二度と使われぬようにする。王はクリスタルを溶岩に入れ、沈んでいくのを見つめる。

WynnExcavation Site D#032.src: Though it contains some of the most concentrated magical power ever, it is still limited to its container. Let it burn.
WynnExcavation Site D#032.dst: 史上もっとも凝縮された魔力の一つを秘めているとはいえ、それでも器の限界からは出られぬ。焼かせてしまおう。

WynnExcavation Site D#033.src: You have done this province an unspeakable service. I believe that even Bob is smiling down on you, today. I'm sure that if he were here with us, he would crown you worthy.
WynnExcavation Site D#033.dst: お前はこの地方に言葉では言い表せぬ功績を残した。今日は Bob すらお前に微笑んでいると思う。あの者がここにいたなら、きっとお前を値する者と認めたであろう。

WynnExcavation Site D#034.src: As a token of our city's eternal gratitude, I wish for you to take this. It has no value to anyone except you.
WynnExcavation Site D#034.dst: 我が街の永遠の感謝の証として、これを受け取ってほしい。お前以外の誰にとっても価値のないものだ。

WynnExcavation Site D#035.src: You might want to hold onto it, a merchant in {p} has arrived and you will be able to trade it for the item that I wish I could bestow upon you now.
WynnExcavation Site D#035.dst: 持っておくとよい。{p}に商人が来ている。いま授けてやれたらと思うあの品と、それで交換できるはずだ。

WynnExcavation Site D#036.src: You truly are one of the greatest warriors to ever step foot in these lands. I hereby knight you as Wynn's true protector for your deeds today. I hope we meet again, young master.
WynnExcavation Site D#036.dst: お前はこの地を踏んだ者の中でも、まことに最も偉大な戦士の一人だ。今日の行いをもって、ここにお前を Wynn の真の守護者として叙任する。また会えることを願っている、若き主よ。

WynnExcavation Site D#037.src: Hm? Oh, hello. May I help you? A clock? Hm, no, I haven't been in the business for quite some time. My apologies.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.dst: ん？ああ、こんにちは。何かご用ですか？時計？いえ、もうずいぶん前にこの仕事からは離れました。申し訳ない。

WynnExcavation Site D#038.src: Though... I suppose if you'd like to take a look at the remains of my work, I can allow that. Let me just find...
WynnExcavation Site D#038.dst: とはいえ……わたしの仕事の名残をご覧になりたいのなら、それは構いません。少し探させてください……

WynnExcavation Site D#039.src: Ah. My basement key appears to have gone missing. Well, I do remember having it on me this morning, so it can't have gone far.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.dst: ああ。地下室の鍵が見当たらないようだ。いや、今朝は持っていた覚えがあるので、遠くへ行ったはずはない。

WynnExcavation Site D#040.src: If you'd be so kind as to find my key, you may certainly help yourself to whatever you find in the basement. I believe I took a walk in the southeast block earlier today, that could be a place to start.
WynnExcavation Site D#040.dst: 鍵を見つけてくださるなら、地下室で見つけたものはご自由にどうぞ。今日は早くに南東の区画を歩いた覚えがあります。そこから探すとよいかもしれません。

WynnExcavation Site D#041.src: I remember being told something by my adoptive father, and he was a king of {p} himself!
WynnExcavation Site D#041.dst: 養父から聞いたことがあるんだ。しかも養父は {p} の王その人だったんだぞ！

WynnExcavation Site D#042.src: Talk to Royal Advisor Carlos in {p} Castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site C)
WynnExcavation Site D#042.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} 城で Royal Advisor Carlos と話す (C 地点の欠片が必要)

WynnExcavation Site D#043.src: His majesty Lord King of {p} is indisposed at this moment.
WynnExcavation Site D#043.dst: {p} 国王陛下は、ただいまご都合がつきません。
WynnExcavation Site D#043.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#045.src: He hasn't been seen since. Only the King knows how to get into the panic room, but I've had my suspicions about it for a while now.
WynnExcavation Site D#045.dst: それ以来お姿を見た者はおりません。避難室への入り方は陛下しかご存じありませんが、私は以前から怪しいと思っていたのです。
WynnExcavation Site D#045.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#046.src: He seemed to be expecting someone, but I'm fed up of waiting.
WynnExcavation Site D#046.dst: 誰かを待っておられたようですが、私はもう待ちくたびれました。
WynnExcavation Site D#046.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#047.src: I managed to hear a few things he was muttering to himself just before he disappeared, though.
WynnExcavation Site D#047.dst: ですが、お姿を消される直前の独り言を、いくつか聞き取ることができました。
WynnExcavation Site D#047.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#048.src: He mentioned something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#048.dst: 第四のクリスタルのことを…緑のものだと仰っていました。
WynnExcavation Site D#048.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#050.src: Please, we need to find him, I'm sick of telling everyone he's indisposed!
WynnExcavation Site D#050.dst: どうか陛下を見つけてください、ご不在の言い訳はもううんざりです！
WynnExcavation Site D#050.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#051.src: Find the secret passageway inside of the throne room
WynnExcavation Site D#051.dst: 玉座の間にある隠し通路を見つける

WynnExcavation Site D#052.src: Oh my, a secret passage has opened up beneath the throne! Quickly, head inside!
WynnExcavation Site D#052.dst: なんと、玉座の下に隠し通路が！さあ、早く中へ！
WynnExcavation Site D#052.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#053.dst: {p} 城の地下の秘密を探る

WynnExcavation Site D#055.src: I am impressed you managed to find me. Someone of my intellect is not normally found when he hasn't the intention of being so.
WynnExcavation Site D#055.dst: よく私を見つけたものだ。私ほどの知性の持ち主は、見つかるつもりがなければ普通は見つからぬものなのだがな。
WynnExcavation Site D#055.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#056.src: I suppose I at least owe you the truth for getting this far, not that it matters.
WynnExcavation Site D#056.dst: ここまで来た褒美に、せめて真実くらいは教えてやろう。どうせ何も変わらんがな。
WynnExcavation Site D#056.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#057.src: WynnExcavation, the Gavel company is a fake, a facade. It's not real....
WynnExcavation Site D#057.dst: WynnExcavation、あの Gavel の会社は偽物、見せかけだ。実在などしない…
WynnExcavation Site D#057.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#058.src: It's actually a secret society run by the high and mighty of Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#058.dst: 実際は Gavel の権力者どもが動かす秘密結社なのだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#058.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#059.src: They have one goal, complete control.
WynnExcavation Site D#059.dst: 目的はただ一つ、完全な支配だ。
WynnExcavation Site D#059.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#060.src: You can't compete with them, kid. I tried to at first, but they had turned my inner circle before getting to me.
WynnExcavation Site D#060.dst: 奴らには敵わんよ、小僧。私も最初は抗ったが、奴らは私に迫る前に側近を寝返らせていた。
WynnExcavation Site D#060.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#061.src: Though I cannot admit I fought hard, their ideals are admirable.
WynnExcavation Site D#061.dst: 必死に戦ったとは言えんが、奴らの理想は立派なものだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#061.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#062.src: So I hope you will forgive me, I act only for the greater good of the world.
WynnExcavation Site D#062.dst: だから許してくれ。私はただ世界のより大きな善のために動いておるのだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#062.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#063.src: As you will not be leaving the city, I wish you a fond farewell. When you leave, you will be accused of treason and will be hunted. It is the only way...
WynnExcavation Site D#063.dst: お前はこの街から出られぬだろうから、心から別れを告げよう。ここを出れば反逆罪に問われ、追われる身となる。これしか道はないのだ…
WynnExcavation Site D#063.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#065.src: Time is short, so I'll have to spare you the details, but let's just say I'm on your side.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.dst: 時間がないから詳しくは話せないが、とにかく俺はあんたの味方だ。
WynnExcavation Site D#065.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#066.src: The King just placed you under arrest for treason. They've locked down the entire city.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.dst: 王があんたを反逆罪で逮捕させた。街全体が封鎖されてる。
WynnExcavation Site D#066.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#067.src: Both the front gate and the Passage are closed down. So we've created another exit for you.
WynnExcavation Site D#067.dst: 正門も通路も閉鎖された。だから俺たちで別の出口を用意しておいた。
WynnExcavation Site D#067.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#068.src: Just follow the path to your left around the city. Keep going until you see a villager next to a tunnel. We'll clear your name once you've escaped.
WynnExcavation Site D#068.dst: 左の道を進んで街を回り込め。トンネルの横に村人がいるから、そこまで行くんだ。逃げ延びたら俺たちが汚名を晴らしてやる。
WynnExcavation Site D#068.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#069.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.dst: 途中で軍の本部を通るから、戦う覚悟をしておけ。ここで味方の衛兵は俺だけだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#069.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#070.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#070.dst: さあ走れ！一刻も無駄にできない！
WynnExcavation Site D#070.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#073.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!
WynnExcavation Site D#073.dst: これを持って逃げろ！早く出るんだ！

WynnExcavation Site D#074.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.
WynnExcavation Site D#074.dst: その座標へ向かえ。説明してる暇はない、行け！トンネルは後ろで塞いでおく。

WynnExcavation Site D#075.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!
WynnExcavation Site D#075.dst: 裏切り者を見つけたぞ！こっちだ！

WynnExcavation Site D#076.src: Head to the location on the note
WynnExcavation Site D#076.dst: メモに書かれた場所へ向かう

WynnExcavation Site D#078.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#078.dst: 悪いけど、中には入れられないよ。
WynnExcavation Site D#078.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#079.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#079.dst: 入れるわけにはいかない。本当に僕らの味方だと証明するまではね。
WynnExcavation Site D#079.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.dst: もう誰を信じればいいかわからないんだ。残念だけど、君が忠誠を証明する方法はないよ。
WynnExcavation Site D#080.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#081.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.dst: じゃあ失礼するよ。Dernel の失われた地図の欠片を探さないと。きっとこの目玉たちが関係してるはずなんだ…
WynnExcavation Site D#081.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#082.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.
WynnExcavation Site D#082.dst: 目玉をたどって地図の欠片を3つ見つけ、Thomas のもとへ戻る。

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#083.dst: 入れられないよ。大事な文書を探してて忙しいんだ。きっとこの目玉たちが関係してるはず…
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#084.dst: それは…地図の欠片？見つけてくれたんだね！
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#085.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.dst: なんてこった、早く入って。
WynnExcavation Site D#085.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#086.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#086.dst: 時間がない！その欠片を僕らのと合わせないと！
WynnExcavation Site D#086.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#087.dst: 急いで、隠れ家に入って！
WynnExcavation Site D#087.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#088.dst: 裏切り者の野営地に入る

WynnExcavation Site D#090.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#090.dst: ようこそ、友よ。君ならすべて見抜くと思っていたよ。
WynnExcavation Site D#090.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#091.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#091.dst: 私に会って驚いただろう。C 地点の発掘隊は、本気で私を殺そうとしたからね。
WynnExcavation Site D#091.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#092.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#092.dst: だが失敗した。私は逃げ出し、地図の欠片をひとつ盗んで、その用途を突き止めたんだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#092.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#093.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#093.dst: ここまで来たなら、Wynn Excavation が見かけ通りでないのはわかるだろう。奴らは Wynn の古の力を使おうとしている。
WynnExcavation Site D#093.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#094.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#094.dst: 奴らは政府も当局も牛耳り、逆らう者の常に {~} 歩先を行っているようだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#094.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#095.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#095.dst: ただし、最後のクリスタルを奴らより先に手に入れられれば話は別だ。
WynnExcavation Site D#095.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#096.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#096.dst: すべてを揃えない限り、奴らは欠片の力を一つも使えない。
WynnExcavation Site D#096.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#098.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#098.dst: WynnExcavation は本当にひどいことをしてきた。僕も昔は手伝ってたんだ…
WynnExcavation Site D#098.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#099.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#099.dst: 何があろうと、WynnExcavation は潰してやる！
WynnExcavation Site D#099.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#104.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#104.dst: おやおや。お前か。驚きはしないな、ここに来るほど愚かだろうと思っていたよ。
WynnExcavation Site D#104.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#105.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#105.dst: ここに来るほど愚かで、辿り着けるほどには賢い。
WynnExcavation Site D#105.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#106.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#106.dst: お前はどの現場にも現れ、欠片を奪って我々の邪魔をしようとした。
WynnExcavation Site D#106.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#107.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#107.dst: 今回は我々の勝ち、お前の負けだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#107.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#108.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#108.dst: クリスタルを4つとも揃えた我々に、お前の欠片が何の意味を持つ？
WynnExcavation Site D#108.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#109.dst: 何の意味もない、そういうことだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#109.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#110.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#110.dst: ボスがお前と話したいそうだ。待たせないほうがいい、気の長いお方じゃないからな。
WynnExcavation Site D#110.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#111.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#111.dst: ボスがお待ちだ。その扉を抜けて行け。
WynnExcavation Site D#111.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#112.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#112.dst: Uci ボスはちょっと意地悪だけど、手下にもいい役得があるんだよな！
WynnExcavation Site D#112.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#113.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#113.dst: ここはダンジョンの奥へ続いてるけど、向こう側から起動しないといけないみたい。
WynnExcavation Site D#113.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#115.dst: パルクールをクリアする

WynnExcavation Site D#119.dst: 緑の部屋から脱出する

WynnExcavation Site D#121.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#121.dst: ほう、ほう。ようやく辿り着いたようだな。
WynnExcavation Site D#121.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#122.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#122.dst: ここで私を見て、少々驚いているかもしれんな…
WynnExcavation Site D#122.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#123.dst: すべては計画通りだったのさ…
WynnExcavation Site D#123.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#124.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#124.dst: 砂漠であの老いぼれを見つけたのも、あの落下で生き延びたのも。
WynnExcavation Site D#124.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#125.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#125.dst: あの手帳を見つけたのも、そして最後に私と出会ったのも。
WynnExcavation Site D#125.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#126.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#126.dst: お前のしてきたことはすべて、この組織の黒幕が仕組んだもの。つまり、この私だ。
WynnExcavation Site D#126.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#128.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#128.dst: 我々に必要だったのは、何も知らず、ある種の純粋な意志を持つ人間だ。力を得た欠片をここへ運ばせるためにな。他の者なら欠片を持ち逃げし、我々に歯向かっただろう。そういう仕組みなのだ。理解してもらおうとは思わん…さて。話は終わりだ。
WynnExcavation Site D#128.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#129.dst: The Ancient City へテレポートする

WynnExcavation Site D#130.dst: The Ancient City を探索する

WynnExcavation Site D#133.src: The crystals combine the power of the stars themselves.. an ultimate power... the power to reign over the entire WORLD!
WynnExcavation Site D#133.dst: クリスタルは星々そのものの力を束ねる…究極の力…「全世界」を支配する力だ！
WynnExcavation Site D#133.speaker: Corrupted Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#135.src: I- I- I feel... unstoppable.. this power... will not allow me to lose..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#135.dst: わ、わ、私は…止められない…この力が…ま、負けを許さない…！！！
WynnExcavation Site D#135.speaker: Shadow Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#137.src: DID YOU REALLY THINK YOU COULD WIN?!?! YOU ARE NOTHING COMPARED TO ME! NOTHING!! I WILL EXTERMINATE ALL LIFE, STARTING WITH YOU!! NOW, PERISH!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#137.dst: 本気で勝てると思ったのか？！お前など私の足元にも及ばない！無に等しい！！あらゆる生命を根絶やしにしてやる、まずはお前からだ！！さあ、滅びろ！！！
WynnExcavation Site D#137.speaker: Amadel
